_comment: Refit 2026-11-12 from ~/bags/tune_1947 (firmware a85b515 re-calibrated speed loop). Fitted by integrating the recorded /cmd_vel through this model and minimising the pose error against the recorded /odometry: XY RMSE 0.376 m, yaw RMSE 13.4 deg, endpoint error 0.038 m over the 55 s out-and-back. The previous model (v_gain 0.55 / wz_gain 0.52 / deadband 0.1406 in a -45 deg chassis frame) scores 2.14 m / 3.06 m endpoint on the same bag and is obsolete: it described the RC path, which the host command path does not use.
v_gain_note: steady-state cmd speed bins: 0.22-0.30 -> 1.15, 0.30-0.38 -> 1.00, 0.38-0.47 -> 0.92; direction error median -3 deg (p10 -9, p90 +7)
wz_gain_note: 0.30 s smoothed |wz|>0.15 linear fit slope 0.72 (corr 0.94); a 3.2 s plateau at cmd -0.80 settled near -0.9 rad/s
deadband_v_note: no deadband on the host path; cmd 0.00-0.03 m/s still shows 0.017 m/s of wheel motion
deadband_w_note: same: no deadband on the host path
frame_yaw_note: cmd_vel_to_unified frame_yaw (-2.356194) -- carried for documentation; irrelevant while both deadbands are 0
lag_tau_note: first-order lag from the trajectory fit; a 0->-0.8 rad/s step ramps over ~0.4 s
